title: Ryan Gosling pack
description: a resource pack for ryan gosling
body:
A Ryan Gosling themed texture pack. Each Vanilla texture is overlayed with Ryan Gosling's face, it's best to not ask why.

I am currently planning on expanding and adding more textures, as of right now it is very bare-bones. 

Here is a video showcasing the pack: https://youtu.be/koWNmBYrcOc
